title: Hesperidin inhibits biofilm formation, virulence and staphyloxanthin synthesis in methicillin resistant Staphylococcus aureus by targeting SarA and CrtM: an in vitro and in silico approach.
authors: Vijayakumar, Karuppiah; Muhilvannan, Seralathan; Arun Vignesh, Mani
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过体外实验和分子对接评估橙皮苷靶向SarA和CrtM抑制MRSA生物膜与毒力，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法仅简单对接，与TF-DNA课题关联弱。
abstract: Methicillin resistant Staphylococcus aureus is considered multidrug resistant bacterium due to developing biofilm formation associated with antimicrobial resistance mechanisms. Therefore, inhibition of biofilm formation is an alternative therapeutic action to control MRSA infections. The present study revealed the non-antibacterial biofilm inhibitory potential of hesperidin against ATCC strain and clinical isolates of S. aureus. Hesperidin is a flavanone glycoside commonly found in citrus fruit. Hesperidin has been shown to exhibits numerous pharmacological activities. The present study aimed to evaluate the antibiofilm and antivirulence potential of hesperidin against MRSA. Results showed that hesperidin treatment significantly impedes lipase, hemolysin, autolysin, autoaggregation and staphyloxanthin production. Reductions of staphyloxanthin production possibly increase the MRSA susceptibility rate to H(2)O(2) oxidative stress condition. In gene expression study revealed that hesperidin treatment downregulated the biofilm-associated gene (sarA), polysaccharide intracellular adhesion gene (icaA and icaD), autolysin (altA), fibronectin-binding protein (fnbA and fnbB) and staphyloxanthin production (crtM). Molecular docking analysis predicted the ability of hesperidin to interact with SarA and CrtM proteins involved in biofilm formation and staphyloxanthin production in MRSA.
abstract_zh: 耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（Methicillin resistant Staphylococcus aureus）因形成与抗菌药物耐药机制相关的生物膜而被视为多重耐药菌。因此，抑制生物膜形成是控制MRSA感染的替代治疗策略。本研究揭示了橙皮苷（hesperidin）对金黄色葡萄球菌ATCC菌株及临床分离株的非抗菌性生物膜抑制潜力。橙皮苷是一种常见于柑橘类水果中的黄烷酮糖苷，已被证明具有多种药理活性。本研究旨在评估橙皮苷对MRSA的抗生物膜和抗毒力潜力。结果表明，橙皮苷处理显著抑制脂肪酶、溶血素、自溶素、自聚集及金黄色葡萄球菌黄素（staphyloxanthin）的产生。金黄色葡萄球菌黄素产生的减少可能增加MRSA对H(2)O(2)氧化应激条件的敏感性。基因表达研究显示，橙皮苷处理下调了生物膜相关基因（sarA）、多糖胞内黏附基因（icaA和icaD）、自溶素（altA）、纤连蛋白结合蛋白（fnbA和fnbB）及金黄色葡萄球菌黄素产生（crtM）的表达。分子对接分析预测了橙皮苷与参与MRSA生物膜形成和金黄色葡萄球菌黄素产生的SarA和CrtM蛋白相互作用的能力。
